The whole island, just for us.

Three nights on a private beach in Isla Blanca. Our people, one hotel we book end to end, and the Caribbean going gold every evening.

Punta Blanca · Beachfront Boutique Hotel · Costa Mujeres, Mexico

The plan

We invite about 120, land somewhere near 70, book Punta Blanca end to end, and fly everyone in for three nights they will never stop talking about.

120
Invited
narrowing toward about 70
~42
Beds on the property
all 14 suites & casitas, ours alone
~30+
Stay just up the beach
nearby Costa Mujeres hotels, same coaches

Here is the honest shape of it. The property sleeps roughly 42, so the wedding party, both families, and our closest people take the rooms on-site. Everyone past that stays at a nearby hotel in Costa Mujeres or Playa Mujeres, about 20 to 35 minutes away, and rides the same coaches we run for the weekend. The venue itself scales well past the beds, so all 70 celebrate together on Saturday whether they sleep on the sand or up the road.

The itinerary

Four days, sand to sand

Thursday · arrivals

Land, ride, exhale On us

Coaches run straight from Cancún International. It is about an hour out through Playa Mujeres to Isla Blanca, and the last kilometer of soft sand road is where it starts to feel like ours. On-site guests check in; off-site guests get dropped at their hotel and picked up again. Breakfast is included from day one.

Friday · rehearsal

Sunset on the water On us

The whole group boards a private catamaran for the rehearsal party. Open bar, music, the Caribbean turning gold. Not a stuffy rehearsal dinner, a sail. Entirely our gift.

Saturday · the wedding

The main event

A barefoot ceremony on 14.5 meters of private ocean frontage, dinner at long tables under a canopy of string lights, dancing in the sand by the DJ booth until the stars take over. Because we hold every room, the property is ours for the night. No strangers, no shared lobby, no other party.

Sunday · slow goodbye

One more coffee

Breakfast on the sand, a lazy morning by the pools, then the coaches carry everyone back to the airport. Nobody scrambles for a taxi. We planned the exit too.

The timing

Why October or November

Warm water, cooler air Summer sargassum mostly gone A real break from NJ’s first cold Quiet shoulder season

One honest planning note: Atlantic hurricane season runs through November 30, and Punta Blanca keeps a published hurricane policy. Late November is the safer window, and we would ask guests to book refundable flights and travel insurance. Worth confirming a date with the hotel early, since a full-property buyout books out fast.

The venue

A place built for destination weddings

Celebrate with the sea breeze, sunset colors, and the warmth of a space made for people who want something different, not a factory-line ballroom. Punta Blanca is a beachfront boutique hotel restored with respect for its natural essence: wood, stucco, pampas, and open Caribbean.

Private beach · 14.5 m ocean frontage Event palapa · 10.5 m × 5 m String-lit sand dance floor DJ & sound on the beach Shoreline ceremony arch Full-property buyout

Seating that scales

Fits our 70, and then some

The photos show the beach set for about 50 at two long farm tables. The same shoreline and palapa scale up: extend the long runs and add a few rounds for 70, or switch to rounds of ten spread across the sand and palapa to seat closer to 120. We size the layout to the final headcount. Play with it on the Plan It tab.

The setting

Why Isla Blanca

About 35 minutes from Cancún’s Hotel Zone and roughly an hour from the airport, on a stretch with no big resorts and no crowds. That is the whole point.

Turquoise, calm water Low sargassum in season Lagoon & mangroves Peace, privacy, silence

Quietly conscious luxury. Largely solar-powered, water drawn from cenote-fed wells, rainwater harvested for reuse. Luxury measured in sensations and silence, not stars on a plaque.

Address: Santa Fátima 3 Blvd., Costa Mujeres, 77400 Cancún, Q.R., Mexico. The last kilometer is unpaved but passable for any vehicle, including our coaches.

The money, honestly

Who pays for what

Simple split: guests cover their own room, and we cover the experience, the parts that make it a wedding and not just a trip. Peso amounts are the hotel’s starting rates; USD is approximate at 1 USD ≈ 17.4 MXN (rate on 07/23/2026).

The pitch, in one line

Everyone we love, on one private beach, for the price of a nice long weekend.

Guests spend about what a mid-range hotel stay costs and get an oceanfront suite with breakfast, a sunset catamaran party, and a wedding with their feet in the sand. We handle flights-to-front-door logistics so no one has to think.

If we keep it at 70

42 of our favorite people wake up on the sand, 28 more are five minutes away, and everyone dances together.

That is the sweet spot: full property, full beach, and a number that still feels like a wedding and not a convention.
